report:
Precall review; no provider call, no writes.

Frozen v2: 3/3 payload sha256 match manifest; base 37a56eb = HEAD. Checkout does not yet carry tools/pi-worker-task.mjs or .audit/verify-pi-worker-44.mjs; commit must carry all three bytes (expected).

Six v1 blockers: all closed. (1) shared exported matchesBoundaryControls, exact 6 fields, verifier asserts accept/reject; (2) top-level finally closes listener, disposes session, removes temp roots on success and catch paths; (3) refreshOnCreate:true + hasConfiguredAuth preflight + allowModelNetwork:false; offline-v2 PASS proves it on this host; (4) stat imported/awaited, missing node/auth negative controls; (5) remainingBudget from processStartedAt; (6) cat-file -e BASELINE^{commit}. No material regression. Residual non-blocker: post-abort protected check/tree still runs after the 110 s budget, so an in-flight 10 s tool at deadline could approach the 120 s outer kill and lose pi-result.json evidence.

BLOCKER (Spec): .audit/verify-pi-worker-44-teardown.mjs prepends gate + taskBytes. The real prepared task starts `#!/usr/bin/env node`; shebang becomes line 2 → Node SyntaxError (verified via --input-type=module --check and data-URL import). The proven control used a shebang-less task, so it did not cover the real artifact shape. The single authorized LunaHigh run would die before any prompt; lifecycle failure; no evidence. Fix: insert gate after the shebang line or strip it.

verify-pi-worker-44-parent.mjs: protected/authorized-path checks plus bwrap rerun, 4 controls PASS; no critical risk (symlink hard-assert is minor).

Verdict: frozen payload Standards PASS; precall Spec FAIL (1 blocker). Route/effort/12-cap/bwrap/credential-never-mounted/empty-loader per spec; not actual model proof.
